_meta.purpose: The manually approved high-value page list, for MASTER SPEC §10. Only slugs listed here may receive word-by-word data, a visible FAQ, or extra verified context.

rules.notAutomatic: A page is never added here because it looks popular. Addition requires the owner's explicit approval, recorded with a date.
rules.noRicherClaims: Priority status permits MORE VERIFIED DETAIL, never more assertion. Every additional statement must still be sourced.
rules.faqGate: A visible FAQ requires all four §4 conditions, including an existing approved FAQ component. None exists in the locked design system today, so no FAQ may be generated.
rules.wordByWordGate: Word-by-word Arabic requires a verified word-level dataset. None exists for this corpus, and Arabic word meanings are never AI-generated, so the section stays omitted.
